title: 第三章 天外异灵第四章 服炁
content_zh:
李一元的住所是后院正房，共有三间，分别是卧室、书房和静室。
周无纪对这里非常熟悉，他径直进了卧室，熟练扭动木柜上机扩把手，打开了暗锁，推开沉重木柜露出向下通道。
把木柜恢复原位，周无纪在下面锁死了机关。
外面人再想进来，只能强行破开遮蔽地道的沉重铁板。
没有合适工具，外面的人一时半会进不来。
沿着青石台阶下了丈许，就是一间青砖堆砌的地下密室。
密室有一扇厚重铁门，铁门外面是一个天然山洞。沿着山洞向下，有条山中暗河直通外面九源江。
李一元在这里准备了一艘小舟，通过九源江顺流直下能日行几百里。
周无纪作为李一元最亲近弟子，对这条逃生暗道的情况非常了解。
有这条退路，周无纪也就没急着跑。
他用火折子点燃油灯，密室顿时铺满了昏黄灯光。
密室很小，只有一张简陋木桌，靠墙摆着两口木箱和一个尺许高葫芦，此外再无他物。
周无纪随手打开一个木箱，里面是层叠的金子。
一共二十个十两的金饼，也就是两百两。
折算成他上一世货币，购买力大概等于两百万，说起来也是一大笔钱。
不过，堂堂七品道士积攒一辈子就这么点存款，周无纪觉得师父实在是太要脸了……
周无纪只是看了一眼，确认金子没问题就关好木箱。
他目光转到那个贴着大量法符葫芦上，这里面装的一只煞鬼。
这方世界灵气强盛，人死后的灵都不会立即消散。
横死之人戾气不散，就有机会转为就凭厉鬼

厉鬼得地气滋养，就能成为阴魂不散的八品凶鬼。
凶鬼饮食血煞精气，就变成了七品煞鬼。
成为煞鬼就能干涉现实，可以吸取生灵的神魂灵性。
葫芦里这只煞鬼，杀了数十人。甚至可以在黑夜中化为实形，很是厉害。
这种煞鬼对气血强盛的武者没什么威胁。反过来说，普通武者对于煞鬼也没什么好办法。
正因为妖魔鬼怪横行，专门降魔伏妖的道门、佛门都有着极高地位，很得朝廷官府的倚重。
李一元收了这只煞鬼，却一直没有灭掉，而是用法符封印在葫芦里藏在密室。
周无纪一直都不明白，师父养只煞鬼藏着有什么用。
现在他明白了，因为北帝天刑书需要煞鬼。
法符上的复杂朱红符文在昏暗灯光下默默闪耀，红得有些刺眼。
周无纪深吸口气再次召唤出北帝天刑书。
content_en:
Li Yiyuan's residence is the main house in the backyard. There are three rooms in total, namely a bedroom, a study room and a quiet room.
Zhou Wuji was very familiar with this place. He went straight into the bedroom, skillfully twisted the expansion handle on the wooden cabinet, opened the secret lock, and pushed open the heavy wooden cabinet to reveal the downward passage.
After restoring the wooden cabinet to its original position, Zhou Wuji locked the mechanism underneath.
If outsiders want to come in, they can only forcefully break through the heavy iron plates that cover the tunnel.
Without the right tools, people from outside may not be able to get in for a while.
About ten feet down the bluestone steps, you will find an underground secret room made of blue bricks.
There is a heavy iron door in the secret room, and outside the iron door is a natural cave. Going down the cave, there is an underground river in the mountain that leads directly to the Jiuyuan River outside.
Li Yiyuan prepared a small boat here, which could travel hundreds of miles a day through the Jiuyuan River.
As Li Yiyuan's closest disciple, Zhou Wuji knew the situation of this secret escape passage very well.
With this escape route, Zhou Wuji was in no hurry to run away.
He lit the oil lamp with a fire stick, and the secret room was suddenly filled with dim light.
The secret room was very small, with only a simple wooden table, two wooden boxes and a gourd about a foot high placed against the wall, and nothing else.
Zhou Wuji casually opened a wooden box, which contained layers of gold.
There are twenty gold cakes worth ten taels in total, which is two hundred taels.
Converted into the currency of his previous life, his purchasing power was approximately equal to two million, which was a lot of money.
However, a dignified seventh-grade Taoist priest has accumulated only such a small amount of savings in his whole life. Zhou Wuji felt that the master was really shameful...
Zhou Wuji just took a look at it, made sure that the gold was fine, and closed the wooden box.
His eyes turned to the gourd with a large number of talismans attached to it, which contained an evil spirit.
The spiritual energy in this world is so strong that even the spirit of a person after death will not dissipate immediately.
If a person who dies violently is still angry, he will have the opportunity to turn into a vicious ghost.
When fierce ghosts are nourished by earth energy, they can become eighth-level evil ghosts that linger.
The evil ghost eats blood evil spirit and becomes a seventh grade evil ghost.
Becoming a ghost can interfere with reality and absorb the soul and spirituality of living beings.
This evil spirit in the gourd killed dozens of people. It can even turn into a real form in the dark, which is very powerful.
This kind of evil spirit poses no threat to warriors with strong Qi and blood. On the other hand, ordinary warriors have no good way to deal with evil spirits.
Precisely because demons and ghosts are rampant, Taoist and Buddhist sects that specialize in subduing demons have a very high status and are highly relied upon by the imperial government.
Li Yiyuan took in the evil spirit, but never destroyed it. Instead, he sealed it in a gourd with a magic talisman and hid it in a secret room.
Zhou Wuji never understood the use of his master raising a evil spirit to hide.
Now he understands, because the Beidi Heavenly Punishment Book needs evil spirits.
The complex vermilion runes on the talisman shone silently under the dim light, and the red was a bit dazzling.
Zhou Wuji took a deep breath and summoned the Beidi Heavenly Punishment Book again.
